title: Flood, Viet Nam, 30 July 2015 (FL20150730VNM)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Viet Nam, 30 July 2015 (FL20150730VNM), from 4 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

This map provides an overview of satellite detected waters along the coastline of Quang Ninh Province, northern Vietnam. Due to continuous rainfall, a notable increase in inundated areas occurred within this region. Using satellite imagery acquired 02 August 2015 and 28 March 2015, UNITAR-UNOSAT identified approximately 4,731 hectares of flood affected land within the analyzed extent. Several flooded areas are in close proximity to Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.

HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters Along Northern  Coast, Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-along-northern-coast-quang-ninh-province-august-05-2015)
- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters Near Ha Long City, Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-near-ha-long-city-quang-ninh-province-vie-august-04-2015)
- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters Near Hai Phong City, Vietnam](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-near-hai-phong-city-vietnam-august-03-2015)
- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters in Hai Phong Province, Vietnam](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-in-hai-phong-province-vietnam-august-06-2015)
